events.name: Washington Commanders at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Even after Jayden Daniels threw two interceptions and it looked like the Washington Commanders were hurtling toward a painful loss at the New York Giants, teammates remembered what it was like when the franchise quarterback burst onto the scene in...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jayden Daniels and Commanders rally to stun the Giants 24-21 and keep their hopes alive

events.name: New England Patriots at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Amon-Ra St. Brown wore lederhosen, carried a German flag onto the field, and then went out and scored two touchdowns.
headlines.shortLinkText: St. Brown and Gibbs score 2 TDs each in Lions' 35-10 rout of Patriots after Maye injured in Munich

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: — Some new names had the Kansas City Chiefs looking very young — and very strong.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws 5 TD passes and rookie Johnson runs for 101 yards as Chiefs overwhelm Falcons 35-13

events.name: Houston Texans at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: — Deshaun Watson can talk all he wants about how playing the Houston Texans is just another game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deshaun Watson throws for 312 yards against his old team as the Browns rally past the Texans 27-24

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Kirk Cousins began his second stint with Minnesota by showing just how much of a difference he can make for the Vikings' offense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kirk Cousins has triumphant return as Vikings sack Jordan Love 8 times in 30-10 win over Packers

events.name: Jacksonville Jaguars at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — Trevor Lawrence has found a way to play even better, and he's elevating the Jacksonville offense right along with him.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Lawrence lights up the Titans as the Jaguars roll 40-23 for a sixth win in 7 games

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: — The Indianapolis Colts got the respite they needed.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts' struggling offense does just enough to beat Dolphins 24-22 and snap 5-game skid

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Chuba Hubbard made long gains out of short passes, pushed through tacklers and pulled the mistake-prone Carolina Panthers out of a three-game slide.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hubbard helps the Panthers top the Saints, 20-17, and retain first place in the NFC South

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills are off to the franchise's best start in 35 years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Josh Allen powers Bills past Jets 31-12 for best start in 35 years. New York loses Geno Smith twice

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — The lead-up to Sunday's Seattle-Las Vegas matchup was almost all about Fernando Mendoza, at last receiving his first start as the Raiders' quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks beat Raiders 21-13 as Drew Lock throws for 2 TDs and Seattle sacks Fernando Mendoza 6 times

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Beaux Limmer was snapping the ball, Xavier Smith and Davis Allen were catching it and Kamren Kinchens came up with a key interception.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams win their 4th straight game, overcoming a slow start to crush the Cardinals 34-6

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Christian McCaffrey's first long touchdown catch was straight out of the schoolyard, the second a Kyle Shanahan special for the San Francisco 49ers.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCaffrey's TDs of 74 and 66 yards and Samuel's 70-yard score help 49ers beat Cowboys 46-40

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Joe Burrow and the Cincinnati Bengals didn't wither under the prime-time spotlight.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joe Burrow and Bengals dominate Steelers 38-18 to take AFC North lead alone

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — The Los Angeles Chargers finally won a game — with the type of smashmouth performance that has brought Jim Harbaugh so much success during his coaching career.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers bully the Ravens at the line of scrimmage and earn their first win of the season, 23-20
